landing.heroTitleHtml:
The mine does not stop.
The weather sometimes does.
landing.heroSub: Real-time operational status for blasting, lifting and pit haulage at Mantos Blancos. Wind, visibility, UV and temperature checked against each activity threshold.
landing.liveSubPanel: Same readout as the shift panel · hour {hora}
landing.liveFallback: API unavailable; showing a sample with the same panel thresholds.
landing.alertDefaultRest: Review activity thresholds and rotate personnel by exposure.
landing.accessDesc: The same JWT entry: shift panel, windows, thresholds, N/R/M ventilation and mine atmosphere.
landing.accessHint: Access by authorized account (Mantos / METGO admin user).
landing.actTitle: Each activity has its own limit
landing.actDesc: Blasting, lifting and pit haulage do not share the same wind, visibility or temperature thresholds.
landing.modulesDesc: Actionable information for each shift and each mine activity.
landing.modWindBody: Hourly sustained wind and gust forecast for lifting and blasting, with a 72 h horizon.
landing.modVisBody: Detection of coastal haze and suspended dust that affect truck haulage in the pit.
landing.modUvBody: UV index and ISO 7243 for exposure management and personnel rotation at peak risk hours.
landing.modPdfBody: PDF record of each event and operational decision for audit and risk prevention.
landing.howDesc: Four steps from registering the mine face to documenting the event.
landing.step1Body: Pit or work-face coordinates and linked activities: blasting, lifting, haulage.
landing.step2Body: Wind, visibility, UV and temperature updated every 15 minutes for the exact mine point.
landing.step3Body: Push before projected conditions cross the threshold defined for each critical activity.
landing.step4Body: Execute, postpone or suspend — and keep a PDF report of the event for risk prevention.
landing.faq1q: Which activities does METGO Mantos Blancos cover?
landing.faq1a: Blasting, lift/crane and pit haulage, plus UV exposure, each with its own thresholds.
landing.faq2a: Use Sign in with your authorized account (METGO JWT). After login you see the shift panel at /app.
landing.faq3q: What do I see after login?
landing.faq3a: Shift panel, windows, thresholds, map, dispersion, N/R/M ventilation, sounding, satellite, heat waves and ICAP air.
landing.ctaTitle: Operate to the threshold, not the gut feel
landing.ctaSub: Pilot access for supervisors and risk prevention at Mantos Blancos.
